summary: mkroom.c mkshop owns the current same-count RNG boundary. C reaches mkshop()'s single rnd(100) shop-type roll at line 193, while JavaScript consumes a later rn2(7) instead, showing that its mkshop() search returned before the roll. The C pre-roll branch includes wizard-mode SHOPTYPE handling and admits any nonzero-door room when that environment value is present; js/mkroom.js currently searches only one-door rooms and omits that branch. Port the complete mkshop() pre-roll selection and preserve its ordinary-room filters, lighting, probability walk, big-room override, topologize, and FILL_NORMAL handoff.

source.branch: In mkshop(), wizard mode first reads SHOPTYPE: recognized symbols dispatch to another special-room maker and return, while unset or unrecognized values leave i < 0. The room scan then accepts an ordinary room with no stairs and a valid shop shape when doorct == 1, or when wizard mode has a non-null SHOPTYPE and doorct != 0. After a candidate is found, a dark room is lit, i < 0 consumes exactly rnd(100), big rooms rewrite wand/book shops to general stores, then rtype, topology, and FILL_NORMAL are set.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:1344-1351 makelevel() selects SHOPBASE and calls do_mkroom(), which calls mkroom.c mkshop().
js/mklev.js:769-780 makelevel() selects SHOPBASE and calls js/mkroom.js do_mkroom(), whose SHOPBASE arm calls mkshop().
dependencies: mkroom.c has_dnstairs(), has_upstairs(), invalid_shop_shape(), and isbig() provide the candidate filters and type override; js/mkroom.js contains their current counterparts.

mkroom.c topologize() and FILL_NORMAL mark the chosen room before the makelevel() tail; js/mklev.js:838-840 fill_special_room() then reaches js/shknam.js stock_room() for shop stocking and shopkeeper setup.

nethack-c/upstream/src/options.c:6848-6856 nh_getenv() and :3490 debug-mode wizard state determine the environment-sensitive SHOPTYPE precondition; the JavaScript state exposes state.wizard but currently has no equivalent mkshop branch.
js/shtypes_data.js SHTYPES is the source-order probability table consumed by the single rnd(100) walk; no probability-table change is indicated by this boundary.

evidence: .cache/scan-cache.json at commit 8558244d75d50626b3b5be79d7bd07d0732c6acb reports the assigned row's first divergence at step 772: C rnd(100)=24 from mkshop(mkroom.c:193), versus JS rn2(7)=1; recordedSteps is 1814, giving the queue upper bound 1042.
nethack-c/upstream/src/mkroom.c:101-177 implements SHOPTYPE dispatch and the ordinary-room search; :180-215 performs lighting, rnd(100), isbig() rewriting, topologize(), and FILL_NORMAL.

js/mkroom.js:346-393 implements the matching tail but tests candidate.doorct === 1 unconditionally and has no SHOPTYPE branch, so it can return before random.rnd(100); the next observed JS draw is consistent with makelevel()'s later fillable-room countdown.

The production path is source-general: mklev.c makelevel() -> do_mkroom(SHOPBASE) -> mkshop(), mirrored by js/mklev.js -> js/mkroom.js; the actionable scope is mkshop() and its existing helper/dependency wiring, with no session-specific values.
